name: RINDAX Multi-Platform ATS Job Finder
description: Twice-daily scan of 11 job feeds across 6 ATS platforms (Himalayas, Arbeitnow, RemoteOK, WeWorkRemotely, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby), each normalized into a common schema with freshness and hiring-intent scoring, keyword pre-filtered, then AI-scored by Gemini against a detailed fresher/junior-friendly candidate profile with hard rejection gates (seniority, strict years-of-experience, India exclusion, large enterprise, sales-heavy roles). Deduplicates against Airtable by URL/ID/composite-key and saves the top 10 new highest-priority jobs.

nodes.name: Feed 1-11 (Himalayas, Arbeitnow, RemoteOK, WeWorkRemotely, Greenhouse x3, Lever, Ashby x2)
nodes.notes: 11 parallel calls to public job-board APIs/RSS, each with onError: continueRegularOutput so one dead feed doesn't break the run

nodes.name: Normalize RSS Data
nodes.notes: Branch-detects each feed's shape (Greenhouse/Ashby/Himalayas/Arbeitnow/RemoteOK/Lever/generic RSS) and maps every job into one common schema: title, canonical_url, company, location, description, freshness_status/score, hiring_intent_level/score, plus content hashes for future change-detection

nodes.name: Keyword Pre-Filter
nodes.notes: Hard-negative filter (rejects senior/lead/manager titles, strict 3+yr experience, non-India-eligible, onsite-only, pure sales/BDR roles) then requires at least 1 strong or 2 supporting automation/n8n/API-integration keyword matches before the job is worth an AI call

nodes.name: AI Skill Matching
nodes.notes: Gemini call scoring each job 0-100 against a detailed candidate profile (fresher in AI automation, Assam/India remote, n8n + AI agent + Excel/Power BI skills) across 8 weighted components (experience, skill, fresher-friendliness, work arrangement, India eligibility, company size, communication fit, portfolio acceptance), with explicit hard gates that override the score

nodes.name: Parse AI JSON
nodes.notes: Parses the model's JSON, computes a blended final_priority_score (60% AI match + 15% freshness + 15% hiring intent + 10% source quality) and assigns a priority tier

nodes.name: Dedup Sort & Limit Top 10
nodes.notes: Cross-checks against existing Airtable URLs/Job IDs/composite keys, dedupes within the current batch, sorts by final priority score, and keeps only the top 10 brand-new jobs

nodes.name: Execution Summary
nodes.notes: Logs a run summary: total collected, prefilter-passed, AI-qualified, and new records saved

main.node: Feed 1-11 (Himalayas, Arbeitnow, RemoteOK, WeWorkRemotely, Greenhouse x3, Lever, Ashby x2)
